name: Process Monitor
tags: htop top process monitor cpu cores memory bars system linux
note: A top-style monitor with per-core meters drawn entirely from block characters, colour-graded by load, plus a process table that reorders itself as usage drifts.

name: Character Rain
tags: matrix rain canvas katakana green falling text effect
note: Canvas column rain where each column keeps its own head position and speed; the head glyph is drawn brighter than the trail, and the whole field fades by overpainting rather than clearing.
